description: The item appears to test statutory notification recipients for an HIV screening result in a military setting. The selected option limits notification to the individual, whereas the official key includes both the individual and the unit commander.

The item appears to test which authority must approve an urgent patient transfer under the Medical Service Act when the patient cannot express consent and the guardian is unreachable. The selected public health center director differs from the keyed district head.

The item appears to distinguish personal hygiene, the keyed prevention priority, from vector management, the selected option. These broad labels may overlap in practical prevention, and the stem does not clarify their intended scope.

The item appears to distinguish assessing health consequences of a major public development policy, keyed as healthy public policy, from creating supportive environments, the selected option. Environmental changes frame the scenario, but the key emphasizes policy-level assessment.
evidence: 환경변화가 주민건강에 미치는 부정적 영향을 사전에 평가할 필요성

description: The item appears to distinguish delirium, the keyed diagnosis, from functional neurological symptom disorder, the selected diagnosis, in an acute episode of impaired awareness and responsiveness with abnormal movements despite unrevealing neurological investigations.
evidence: 눈 맞춤은 전혀 되지 않고, 질문에 대답하지 않고 멍하게 의미 없이 고개를 흔든다.
